title: RunMetadata
description: Schema for execution run metadata, host environment specification, and audit configuration.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the audit execution run.

schema_version.description: Semantic version string for run metadata schema.

repo_name.description: Name of the repository or target project being profiled.

source_ref.description: Source revision identifier such as a Git commit SHA, branch, tag, or version.

mode.description: Execution mode of the profiling audit.

target_type.description: Environment classification of the profiled target application.

machine.description: Specification of the host hardware and OS executing the audit.

os.description: Operating system name, version, and architecture.

cpu.description: CPU model name, core count, and frequency.

scope_paths.description: List of file paths, directories, or module identifiers included in the audit scope.

scope_notes.description: Explicit rationale for in-scope selection and exclusions.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp marking when the profiling audit execution began.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp marking when the profiling audit execution completed.

repetitions.description: Number of sequential measured repetitions executed per workflow.

warmups.description: Number of unmeasured warm-up iterations executed per workflow prior to measurement.

data_volume.description: Recorded dataset scale, record counts per collection/table.
